how_picked: H1 pick (2026 Jan-Jun, win % >= 50, plateau score)
rules: Window: Asia 20:00-00:00. Opening range = its first 15 minutes.
Entry: the first 5m close beyond the range, that way.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the breakout candle.
Target 3R. Breakeven (entry + 1.25 pts) once +1.0R was reached.
Time exit: flat at the window end + 60 min. One trade a day. Entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop and time exits - 1 tick; $1.40 a micro.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); stops 6-80 pts.
costs: $1.40 a micro round trip + 1 tick on market entries, stop and time exits (eval views $1.90)
data: TradingView CME NQ1! 5m (data/NQ_5m.csv), 1m for the 2026 trade path (data/NQ_1m.csv)
